race.description: Pryde's Easifeed Stamina 0 To 2 Win Trotters Hcp
race.comment: WHY TANYA SUE (7) comes here following a Group One tenth 17 months ago over 2300m at Menangle, beaten 275 metres by Gatesys Gem. Quality performer who can win first up in this company. NONIS GOLD CLASS (9) won two starts ago then things went amiss last start when she broke and finished a distant seventh over 2138m at this track. Won't find this any harder so she can return to winning form. BLACK VIPER (11) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish second at this track over 2138m. Genuine threat. ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (4) is close to a win after two successive placings, the latest a third over 2138m at this track.
